note: Ready-made walks. The first is the stored walk (data/walk.json, planned ahead in data/routes.json). The others are planned in the page by js/planner.js when chosen. Every stop but one is a place where Curiosity worked (the survey's west bench is ground the rover did not drive to): the position is the rover's end-of-drive position on the sols given (NASA's waypoint file), and the text is from NASA's mission updates, read and rechecked on 14 Nov 2026. The goals are the team's.

own.name: Your own walk
own.goal: You place the stops. The planner finds both routes there and back.

campo.name: Campo Marte drill site
campo.text: In May 2026 Curiosity drilled Campo Marte here, in layered sulfate rock just above the boxwork. Its first try, at a thinner block nearby named Atacama, ended with the drill lodged in the rock.

contact.name: Layer contact
contact.text: In August 2026 Curiosity worked here for six sols, at a place where two rock layers meet and cross-bedded rock is cut off by other layers.

walks.name: Ridge and hollow survey
walks.goal: Sample a boxwork ridge and the hollow beside it, where Curiosity drilled both, then go on to ground the rover did not drive to.

walks.name: First sample run
walks.goal: Go back to Altadena, the first place Curiosity drilled the boxwork bedrock.

walks.name: Sulfate above the boxwork
walks.goal: Compare the boxwork with the layered sulfate rock just above it, at two of Curiosity's drill sites.

walks.name: Climb to the layer contact
walks.goal: Follow Curiosity's climb to the place where two rock layers meet, at the far end of the surveyed patch.
